title: Damages Rate by Length of Supply on Small Business Electricity Supply Termination Fees
content:
**Rate rule.** For the early termination fee on a Small Business Electricity Supply agreement under the per-remaining-kWh method, an agreement under which the site has been supplied for 18 whole months or more, counted from its service start date to the handling date, pays 0.0100 dollars per remaining kWh; one supplied for 12 to 17 whole months pays 0.0115 dollars; one supplied for fewer than 12 whole months pays the plan's damages rate per kWh.

Whole months run by calendar month from the service start date on the agreement record, a month counting only once its day of the month is reached.

| Whole months supplied, service start to handling date | Damages rate per remaining kWh |
|---|---|
| 18 or more | 0.0100 USD |
| 12 to 17 | 0.0115 USD |
| fewer than 12 | the plan's damages rate per kWh |

**Boundary cases (hypothetical, service start 1 April 2025)**

| Handling date | Whole months supplied | Damages rate |
|---|---|---|
| 31 March 2026 | 11 | the plan's damages rate |
| 1 April 2026 | 12 | 0.0115 USD |
| 30 September 2026 | 17 | 0.0115 USD |
| 1 October 2026 | 18 | 0.0100 USD |

**Hypothetical figure.** 40000 remaining kWh at 0.0115 USD come to 460.00 USD; at 0.0100 USD to 400.00 USD.
